instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot at eye-level. Inside an indoor boxing gym, two men spar within a ring with black ropes. On the left, the dark-skinned boxer in red shorts (R2) is hunched forward with his back mostly to the camera, clinching. On the right, the light-skinned boxer in black shorts (R1) stands facing left with his head tucked down. The dark-skinned boxer (R2) presses his head and shoulder closely against the light-skinned boxer (R1) in a tight clinch. Bright overhead gym lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the canvas.
